The domain of $\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x)$ is $x\in [-1,1].$

Now, substituting $x=\frac{1}{2}$ directly into the limit, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \,\frac{1}{2}}\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x)) & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{3}{4}\operatorname{arccos}⁡(\frac{1}{2})) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{3}{4}\cdot \frac{\pi }{3}) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4}) \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
